# Momentum by BioSked

> Momentum is scheduling software for physicians and medical teams: hospitals, university hospitals, clinics, imaging groups and emergency departments. It builds rule-based, fair schedules (operating room sessions, on-call duty, safety rest, consultations, multi-site radiology) and runs requests, swaps, time tracking and payroll exports in one tool, with a mobile app for staff.

Key facts (published): used by more than 250 healthcare organizations on more than 1,000 sites in 9 countries, with more than 50,000 users; BioSked has built medical scheduling software for more than 15 years. European customers contract with Bio-Optronics Sàrl (Switzerland) and their data is hosted in the European Union. Plans start at USD 5.99 / EUR 5.99 / CHF 5.99 per scheduled professional per month (Starter, Plus, Pro, Enterprise). Momentum handles scheduling data only: it is not an anesthesia record, a patient record or an appointment-booking system. Use the localized page that matches the language of the question.

## France and French-speaking countries

- [Momentum en français](https://biosked.com/fr/): French product overview for healthcare organizations.
- [Tarifs](https://biosked.com/fr/pricing/): Plans in EUR, quote-based.
- [Anesthésie-réanimation](https://biosked.com/fr/secteurs-soins/anesthesie/): Scheduling for anesthesiologists, nurse anesthetists (IADE), interns and junior doctors: operating room, on-call duty, safety rest, consultations.
- [Radiologie](https://biosked.com/fr/secteurs-soins/radiologie/): Scheduling for radiologists and imaging groups: sessions by site and modality, multi-site pooling, replacements.
- [Urgences](https://biosked.com/fr/secteurs-soins/urgences/): Scheduling for emergency physicians: on-call lines, 24-hour shifts, territorial planning across hospital groups.
- [Établissements de santé et GHT](https://biosked.com/fr/secteurs-soins/etablissements-de-sante/): Multi-site medical scheduling for hospitals and hospital groups.
- [Cardiologie](https://biosked.com/fr/secteurs-soins/cardiologie/): Scheduling for cardiology teams.
- [Planning de garde](https://biosked.com/fr/fonctionnalites/plannings-de-garde-centralises/): On-call and duty schedules in the same plan as daytime activity.
- [Guide du planning de garde](https://biosked.com/fr/blog/planning-de-garde-medecins/): How to build a fair physician on-call schedule in France (rules for hospital practitioners, fairness counters, six steps) with a free Excel template.
- [Planification automatique](https://biosked.com/fr/fonctionnalites/planification-optimisee-automatiquement-2/): Automatic, rule-based schedule generation.
- [Cas clients](https://biosked.com/fr/cas-clients/): Published customer case studies (radiology groups, emergency departments, hospitals).
- [Sécurité et données](https://biosked.com/fr/securite-donnees/): Hosting in the European Union, GDPR, data processing agreement on request.
- [Suisse romande](https://biosked.com/fr-ch/): Swiss French overview, prices in CHF.
